dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Do you have something more recent to mention?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Huh... Looks like this batch isn't good enough for you.

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Well, how about this then! The Sakoku Decree, enforced for so long, is now finally a thing of the past!

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Will the re-opened sea routes bring hope? Or more foes?

dialogues.speaker: Shirai
dialogues.text: Would you like to know more? Well, if you're curious, then you've gotta show your appreciation for such detailed intel, you know?
